Dans ce milieu, la matière organique se décompose lentement, permettant aux minéraux ferreux présents dans les eaux de sédimentation de remplacer la coquille d’origine, formant ainsi un moulage en pyrite.

3D scan of the left humerus of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

# Woodcarving Collection
### Bear-Shaped Pig

> * Beech wood
> * Linseed oil finish
> * Completed on 20th July 2025

I started this wanting to carve a simple cat, but early on it was clear that I picked an overly thick piece of wood. I tried to turn it into a pig, but it seems like the wood was too thick for that too. The wide body and rounded legs make it look more like a bear from every side, other than the one initially shown on the 3D model, where it vaguely resembles a pig. 

It isn't great, but I hope that, in a few years, it'll be a good indicator of how far I've come with my carving skills.

name: ⚠️ Your 3D Art May Be at Risk ⚠️
description:
To all artists, creators, and collectors on Sketchfab:

This post is intended to raise awareness about a risk that affects 3D content shared online. Some model-extraction and graphics-capture tools can be used to obtain geometry and textures from content that is rendered on a user's device. As a result, even models that are intended primarily for viewing may be vulnerable to unauthorized copying.

Many creators invest countless hours, days, or even months into producing high-quality 3D artwork. Unauthorized extraction, redistribution, or commercial use of these works can undermine that effort and harm the artists who make this community possible.

Please respect creators' intellectual property, licensing terms, and permissions. If you discover unauthorized copies of your work, consider reporting them through the appropriate channels and documenting the infringement.

The purpose of this message is to encourage awareness, discussion, and better protection of digital artwork within the Sketchfab community.
